Adoption Process

Adoption Process

 Looking for a loyal, confident, and affectionate companion? Our champion-bred Staffordshire Bull Terrier puppies are raised with care and structure. Whether you're in London, Manchester, Birmingham, or anywhere across the UK, we’ll help you find the perfect puppy for your home. 

Adoption Process

Adoption Process

Adoption Process

Our adoption process is straightforward and easy. We'll guide you through the entire process, from the initial application to the final adoption paperwork. Our goal is to make the process as smooth as possible for both you and your new pet.

Adoption Fees

Adoption Process

Adoption Success Stories

Our adoption fees are affordable and transparent. We believe that everyone should have the opportunity to provide a loving home for a pet, which is why we keep our fees low and include all necessary vaccinations and spay/neuter procedures.

Adoption Success Stories

Adoption Success Stories

Adoption Success Stories

Families from London to Glasgow have welcomed our puppies into their homes. Our Staffords are known for their loving nature, confidence, and correct breed type. We’re proud of every successful match we’ve made. 

Adoption Events

Adoption Success Stories

Adoption Events

 We occasionally host meet‑and‑greet opportunities for approved families. These events allow you to meet our dogs, learn about the breed, and understand our breeding program. Updates will be posted here. 

Foster Program

Adoption Success Stories

Adoption Events

We do not currently offer a foster program. Our focus is on placing puppies in permanent, loving homes with responsible owners. We remain committed to supporting every puppy we produce. 

Our Story

Our Products

Our Mission

At TILLCARR Staffordshire Bull Terriers, we are proud to be a long‑established name in champion‑bred Staffords. Based in Spalding, Lincolnshire, our breeding program is built on decades of experience, dedication, and love for the breed. Every puppy is raised with care, structure, and a commitment to excellence. 

Our Mission

Our Products

Our Mission

Our mission is to produce healthy, confident, and well‑structured Staffordshire Bull Terrier puppies from fully health‑tested parents. We believe every family deserves a loyal companion with stable temperament and true breed type. We proudly serve families across the UK — from London to Glasgow — with puppies raised to the highest standards. 

Our Products

Our Products

Our Products

We offer champion‑bred Staffordshire Bull Terrier puppies with KC‑aligned pedigrees and full health testing. Each puppy comes vet‑checked, vaccinated, microchipped, wormed, and supported for life. Our current litter, born 01/01/2026, features english Blue Staffy puppies from elite TILLCARR bloodlines. 

Our Team

Our Products

Our Products

Our team at TILLCARR Staffordshire Bull Terriers is made up of passionate breeders and dog lovers who live and breathe the Stafford breed. We are hands‑on with every litter, every match, and every family we support. From first enquiry to lifelong guidance, we’re here to help you find your perfect puppy. 

OUR AVAILABLE PUPPIES

Meet our available Blue Staffordshire Bull Terrier puppies, raised with exceptional care and attention. Every puppy is confident, healthy, and well prepared for their new home, with UK‑wide delivery options available.
